event_summary: A bright flame remains on the left red candle and visibly flickers while a similar right red candle remains without a flame.
raw_event_description: The video shows two upright red candles in separate gold-colored holders on a wooden tabletop against a plain wall. From the start, the left candle has a yellow-orange flame at its top, and the right candle has a small dark wick at its top with no visible flame. Across the video, the left flame stays present while its outline, height, and brightness vary slightly; the candles, holders, table, and wall keep the same visible arrangement.

reasons: Both candles and holders are visible from the beginning.
The left candle already has a visible flame in the first frame.
The right candle top and wick are visible without a flame.
